insight.red-sash-pursuer.outcome: Red Trail Pursuit moves up to half Speed plus 5 feet toward its triggering creature.

insight.road-and-wall-adept.outcome: Once per scene improve an Earth wall, road, ramp, shelter, ridge or seal: CL more Hit Points, one printed duration step, or one extra 5-foot section.

insight.silent-foundation.outcome: Once per scene reroll a Dexterity Stealth check failed because of sound; add PB inside your own Dampen Sound or True Silence area.

insight.shieldhook-adept.why: Optional single ally beneficiary of Shield-Catching Beard; next attack, any weapon, with source-owned failed/successful-save expiry.

insight.sand-born-footwork.why: Own Sand Terrain exemption, represented environmental hiding Advantage and optional adjacent Shallow Sand after a missed Opportunity Attack once per scene.

insight.refined-golden-bell.why: One of four activation-bound refinements through the shared choice, defense, save and check-hazard contracts; each activation replaces the selection.

insight.pulse-thread-memory.why: One additional Pulse Seal through the shared mark-cap hook; optional yes/no damage diagnosis through Read the Pulse, without disclosing causes or hidden statistics.

insight.reservoir-core-refinement.why: Second Golden Core Reservoir use per scene; restore the ordinary or Perfected amount before adding one unavoidable Exhaustion level protected from removal or transfer until the scene ends.

insight.restorative-circulation.why: Fresh reviewed once-per-turn single-recipient healing increase with the full-health Temporary HP fallback and the CL12 doubled bonus at 0 Hit Points; one benefit per activation.

insight.shared-breath-method.why: Fresh reviewed rider on the real Feed Current Temporary CP grant to a willing creature; grants nothing on its own.

insight.returning-tide-body.why: Fresh reviewed once-per-scene follow-up (1 Stamina, a 5-foot step provoking no Opportunity Attack, Advantage on the next Grapple before the end of the owner's next turn) after a Jujutsu feature redirects or throws a hostile creature; the new default-inert jujutsu_redirect_or_throw seam in combat/ext/jujutsu.py carries the event (Redirect Force's creature-moving option and Throw's failed-save resolution). The Grapple Advantage rides the table's own model of a Grapple as the target's save, so the owner's Advantage is that save's Disadvantage, consumed by the first attempt and expiring at the end of the owner's next turn.

insight.qi-tempered-concentration.why: Fresh reviewed failed Constitution Concentration save on a Qi-powered feature: the owner's Proficiency Bonus rides the shared d20_bonus seam (2 Qi, the Reaction); the row only records ownership, combat/ext/qi_tempered.py carries the benefit.
